2.2.1. bool_expression_parser.parse.parse¶

bool_expression_parser.parse.parse(expression, neg_sym='~', and_sym='&', or_sym='#', parse_all=True)¶

Parse a boolean expression. Raises a ParseException if parsing fails.

Parameters:
  • neg_sym – Symbol representing negation.
  • and_sym – Symbol representing conjunction.
  • or_sym – Symbol representing disjunction.
  • parse_all – If True, raise an exception if the entire string could not be parsed as a boolean expression. Otherwise, parse until the first unknown symbol and return the parsed result.
Return type:

BoolExpr
Returns:

A BoolExpr representing the expression.
